# OEM Center Caps

> OEM Center Caps (oemcentercaps.com) is a free fitment-information site for
> factory (OEM) wheel center caps. It publishes sourced center-cap sizes and
> part numbers, tells you honestly when a size is not published, and offers a
> free tool that matches a cap by vehicle or by measurement.

- Main site: https://oemcentercaps.com/
- Contact: jtt.imports@hotmail.com (JTT Imports)
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/oemcentercaps

## Free tools

- Cap Finder: https://oemcentercaps.com/cap-finder.html
  Find a cap two ways: by vehicle (from published specs and part numbers), or
  by measure-and-match (enter your measurements; matches within plus or minus
  1.5 mm). Step 1 (measure check) must be confirmed before Step 2 unlocks.
  The Cap Finder is also installable as a web app (PWA).
- How to measure: https://oemcentercaps.com/how-to-measure.html
- Fitment guide: https://oemcentercaps.com/fitment-guide.html
- Cap Concierge: https://oemcentercaps.com/cap-concierge.html

## Honest fitment policy

- Specs are sourced only. Where no OEM size is published, the brand is listed
  as measure-first: Buick, Chrysler, modern Lincoln, Infiniti, Genesis, Fiat.
- Published conflicts are shown openly, not hidden: Tesla and Mazda have
  conflicting published data. The Ram 1500 77.8 mm bore figure is deliberately
  withheld because it is not verified.
- Example: Acura RDX 2010-2017 uses 69 mm outside diameter / 64 mm clip
  diameter, Honda/Acura 44732 family. No RDX-specific OEM part number is
  published, so it is flagged measure-first.

## Where to buy

- Where to buy: https://oemcentercaps.com/where-to-buy.html
  Amazon.ca links there carry the Associate tag uxk-20, with an Associate
  disclosure on the page. eBay links are plain searches (no affiliate
  commission) until an eBay partner campaign is confirmed.
